% trimmarks-twoside.tex -- per-page pageattr gate (twoside, asymmetric bleed).
% The d driver used to patch \@outputpage with \tl_put_left/right:Nx:
% page 2 got no attributes at all (the prefix ran after the page counter
% advanced) and every shipped page raised "Missing number" from the
% unbalanced \ifodd\else...\fi suffix tail (see the git history of
% jlreq-trimmarks.sty 1093-1101). The rework sets the attrs from a
% labeled shipout/before hook that reads the page counter at shipout time.
% Verification: tests/check-trimmarks-pageattr.py dumps every page's raw
% dictionary (pymupdf) and asserts, with gutter=0mm / fore-edge=6mm:
%   odd  pages: BleedBox left  = TrimBox left  (=72.00313)
%               BleedBox right = TrimBox right + 6mm (=587.93110)
%   even pages: BleedBox left  = TrimBox left  - 6mm (=54.99452)
%               BleedBox right = TrimBox right (=570.92250)
%   every page: TrimBox present exactly once, no "Missing number" in the
%   compile log, no papersize special under the d driver.
\documentclass[pdflatex,paper=b5,twoside]{jlreq}
\usepackage[bleed_margin={gutter=0mm,fore-edge=6mm,top=3mm,bottom=3mm}]{jlreq-trimmarks}
\begin{document}あ\newpage い\newpage う\end{document}
